record.field: # Flag the order as "partial delivery", except for the picking types listed in # the system parameter gn_entregas_parciales.tipos_sin_parcial. raw = env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo().get_param('gn_entregas_parciales.tipos_sin_parcial') or '' excluded = [int(x) for x in raw.replace(' ', '').split(',') if x.isdigit()] to_flag = records.filtered_domain([('picking_type_id', 'not in', excluded)]) if excluded else records if to_flag: to_flag.write({'x_studio_partial_delivery': True})

# Cancel the backorder: action_cancel() cancels moves, lines and reservations # (writing the state would leave the moves alive). A note is left first. # Transfers with a product of the categories listed in the system parameter # gn_entregas_parciales.categorias_sin_cancelar are never cancelled. SKIP_STATES = ['done', 'cancel'] raw = env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo().get_param('gn_entregas_parciales.categorias_sin_cancelar') or '' excluded = [int(x) for x in raw.replace(' ', '').split(',') if x.isdigit()] for picking in records.sudo(): if picking.state in SKIP_STATES: continue if excluded and picking.move_ids.filtered_domain([('product_id.categ_id', 'child_of', excluded)]): continue picking.message_post( body='

Esta recepción ha sido cancelada porque se hizo una recepción parcial y el proveedor no acepta entregas parciales.

', body_is_html=True, subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note') picking.action_cancel()
